teaser.en: The incense of the sea side: a coastal Vitex whose fragrant gum is burned like ubani.
teaser.sw: Ubani wa ufukweni: *Vitex* wa pwani ambaye utomvu wake wenye harufu nzuri huchomwa kama ubani.
teaser.dg: 'Ubani wa pwani': *Vitex* ya pwani ambayo gamuye yenye arufu nono nkufukizwa dza ubani.

summary.en: Ubani wa pwani is a seashore Vitex, a shrub or small tree with hand-shaped leaves. Its aromatic exudate is burned as incense, which gives it the name 'incense of the sea side'.
summary.sw: Ubani wa pwani ni *Vitex* wa ufukweni, kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani yenye umbo la kiganja. Utomvu wake wenye harufu huchomwa kama ubani, na hivyo ndivyo ulivyopata jina 'ubani wa pwani'.
summary.dg: *Ubani wa pwani* ni *Vitex* ya kanda-kanda ya bahari, chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza ga umbo ra mkpwono. Gamuye yenye arufu nono nkufukizwa dza ubani, na ndiyo sababu unaihwa 'ubani wa pwani'.

about.en:
*Ubani wa pwani* is a shrub or small tree of the *Vitex* genus. Like its relatives it has digitate leaves, with several leaflets spreading from the tip of a long stalk like the fingers of a hand, which Pakia notes is how the Digo describe *Vitex* leaves.

When the bark is wounded it gives an aromatic gum.
about.sw:
*Ubani wa pwani* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa jenasi *Vitex*. Kama jamaa zake, una majani ya vidole, yenye vijani kadhaa vinavyotawanyika kutoka ncha ya kikonyo kirefu kama vidole vya mkono; Pakia anaeleza kuwa hivi ndivyo Wadigo wanavyoyaeleza majani ya *Vitex*.

Gome likijeruhiwa hutoa utomvu wenye harufu nzuri.
about.dg:
*Ubani wa pwani* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa jenasi ya *Vitex*. Dza nduguze, una makodza ga umbo ra mkpwono: makodza madide kadhaa ganatuluka kula ntsa ya mlita mure, ganaahukana dza vyala vya mkpwono. Pakia anaandika kukala ndivyo Adigo anavyogomba makodza ga *Vitex*.

Gopha richilumizwa, rinalavya gamu yenye arufu nono.

where.en: It grows near the sea, in coastal bush and thicket behind the shore, which is what *wa pwani*, 'of the sea side', refers to.
where.sw: Hukua karibu na bahari, katika vichaka vya pwani na vichaka vizito vilivyo nyuma ya ufuo, na hilo ndilo linalomaanishwa na *wa pwani*, 'wa ufukweni'.
where.dg: Unamera phephi na bahari, kpwenye vitsaka vya pwani virivyo nyuma ya kanda-kanda ya bahari; ndiyo mana ya *wa pwani*, 'wa kanda-kanda ya bahari'.

uses.en: Pakia records that its exudate, an aromatic gum, is used as incense.
uses.sw: Pakia anarekodi kuwa utomvu wake, gundi yenye harufu nzuri, hutumika kama ubani.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala gamuye yenye arufu nono nkuhumirwa dza ubani.

culture.en: *Ubani* is incense, burned to scent the house and in ritual. This shrub is named as the local seaside source of it.
culture.sw: *Ubani* ni uvumba unaochomwa ili kunukisha nyumba na katika matambiko. Kichaka hiki kimepewa jina kama chanzo chake cha hapa ufukweni.
culture.dg: *Ubani* nkufukizwa ili nyumba ikale na arufu nono, na piya kpwenye mila. Dzina ra chitsaka hichi rinaonyesa kukala ndicho chinachopha atu a phapha pwani ubani.

names.en: Pakia records *ubani wa pwani*, 'incense of the sea side', because it grows by the sea and its gum is used as incense. The Mgombato dictionary uses *ubani* both for incense and for the Mexican weeping pine, whose gum is burned in the same way. Other Digo *Vitex* are *mfudu*, *mfudu madzi* and *mfudu unga*. No English or Swahili name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *ubani wa pwani*, 'ubani wa ufukweni', kwa sababu hukua kando ya bahari na utomvu wake hutumika kama ubani. Kamusi ya Mgombato inatumia *ubani* kwa ubani wenyewe na pia kwa msindano wa Mexico (*Mexican weeping pine*), ambao utomvu wake huchomwa kwa namna hiyohiyo. *Vitex* wengine wa Kidigo ni *mfudu*, *mfudu madzi* na *mfudu unga*. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza wala la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *ubani wa pwani*, 'ubani wa kanda-kanda ya bahari', kpwa sababu unamera phephi na bahari na gamuye nkuhumirwa dza ubani. Kamusi ya Mgombato inahumira *ubani* kpwa ubani wenye na kpwa muhi wa *Mexican weeping pine*, ambao gamuye nkufukizwa vivyo. *Vitex* zanjina za Chidigo ni *mfudu*, *mfudu madzi* na *mfudu unga*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza wala ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.sw: chanzo kingine cha utomvu wenye harufu nzuri
reason.dg: muhi wanjina unaolavya gamu yenye arufu nono

mgombato: ubani2 (-) Mexican weeping pine (Pinus patula); the gum of this tree is used for incense; ubani. (See: uvumba)
